hypothesis: Explicit sensor-delta factorization into candidate-independent learned nuisance and candidate-action multiplied learned effect, with unchanged original P50 SSM/attention/TTT/depth trunk, beats fully trained matched P50/GRU/MLP and honest ridge/last-effect on unfamiliar nonlinear causal worlds, including withheld switches and correct-credit negatives.

architecture.new_trainable_model: P50 HybridPilot with original stem/SSM/attention/TTT/depth; head output dimensionality=2, yielding nuisance + factual candidate action * effect; candidate action forced zero in the query input to the shared trunk to make action dependence uniquely explicit in the output factorization.
architecture.historical_observations: Only 8 actually completed physical [sensor, delta, executed_action, dt, nonquery_tag] events; no hidden beta, switch label or unobserved alternative future outcomes in train model input.
architecture.future_query: Current sensor + unknown next-outcome zero + candidate action represented only by final antisymmetric multiplication; query tag=1; all arms same factual history and one actually observed supervised query outcome per fit example.

source.generator: exact original P51 source() function and physics code, with only fresh explicitly frozen per-split seeds; FIT/VAL/unfamiliar frequencies remain same as P51, ensuring causal hypotheses are comparable but independent authored samples.
source.query_factual_supervision: one executed random sign and actual next-sensor; both hypothetical counterfactual actions only in isolated validation/OOD scorer, never fed as training targets

comparison.parameter_bound: must show parameter count; factorized P50 <= 1.02 original P50
comparison.lr_schedule: cosine anneal to 0.0001 over fixed steps
comparison.matching: same train batches/split/observed outcomes/query action across all arms; original P50 and factorized P50 share same torch seed, wrong-credit factorized starts byte-identical to factorized true-credit per seed; cannot claim matched total FLOPs

no_hindsight: Do not change thresholds, seed/source cohort, training steps, generator or comparator arms after consuming evaluation source; preserve nulls and nonplateau.
